issue.title: Retire memory_webs
issue.description: Beta gate for provider-backed memory webs and managed strand rosters.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Memory-web validation, roster rendering, and strand lookup have soaked across project and home memory roots without blocking normal memory init.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Memory notes with web metadata stay ordinary flat memory notes, strand directories are ignored, and no roster edits are planned.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Memory init and doctor discover provider-backed memory webs, validate strand descriptors, and update managed strand rosters.
